Zameen o aasmaan ka har zarra Allah ki tasbeeh mein mashghool hai, aur wahi saahib-e-izzat aur saahib-e-hikmat hai
Imaan waalo! Aakhir woh baat kyon kehte ho jis par amal nahin karte ho
Allah ke nazdeek yeh sakht naaraazgi ka sabab hai ke tum woh kaho jis par amal nahin karte ho
Beshak Allah un logon ko dost rakhta hai jo us ki raah mein is tarah saf baandh kar jihaad karte hain jis tarah seesa pilaayi hui deewaarein

Aur us waqt ko yaad karo jab Moosa alaihis-salaam ne apni qaum se kaha ke qaum waalo! Mujhe kyon aziyyat de rahe ho, tumhein to maaloom hai ke main tumhaari taraf Allah ka rasool hoon. Phir jab woh log tedhe ho gaye to Khuda ne bhi un ke dilon ko tedha hi kar diya, ke Allah badkaar qaum ki hidaayat nahin karta hai

Aur us waqt ko yaad karo jab Eesa bin Maryam alaihis-salaam ne kaha ke aye Bani Israaeel! Main tumhaari taraf Allah ka rasool hoon, apne pehle ki kitaab Tauraat ki tasdeeq karne waala aur apne baad ke liye ek rasool ki bashaarat dene waala hoon jis ka naam Ahmad hai. Lekin phir bhi jab woh mo'jizaat le kar aaye to logon ne keh diya ke yeh to khula hua jaadoo hai
Aur us se bada zaalim kaun hoga jo Khuda par jhoota ilzaam lagaaye, jab ke use Islam ki daawat di ja rahi ho, aur Allah kabhi zaalim qaum ki hidaayat nahin karta hai
Yeh log chaahte hain ke Noor-e-Khuda ko apne munh se bujha dein, aur Allah apne noor ko mukammal karne waala hai chaahe yeh baat kuffaar ko kitni hi naagawaar kyon na ho
Wahi Khuda woh hai jis ne apne Rasool ko hidaayat aur deen-e-haq ke saath bheja hai taake use tamaam adyaan par ghaalib banaaye, chaahe yeh baat mushrikeen ko kitni hi naagawaar kyon na ho
Imaan waalo! Kya main tumhein ek aisi tijaarat ki taraf rehnumaai karoon jo tumhein dardnaak azaab se bacha le
Allah aur us ke Rasool par imaan le aao aur raah-e-Khuda mein apne jaan o maal se jihaad karo, ke yahi tumhaare haq mein sab se behtar hai agar tum jaanne waale ho

Woh tumhaare gunaahon ko bhi bakhsh dega aur tumhein un jannaton mein daakhil karega jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hongi, aur us hamesha rehne waali Jannat mein paakeeza makaanaat honge, aur yahi bahut badi kaamyaabi hai
Aur ek cheez aur bhi jise tum pasand karte ho: Allah ki taraf se madad aur qareebi fatah, aur aap momineen ko bashaarat de dijiye

Imaan waalo! Allah ke madadgaar ban jaao jis tarah Eesa bin Maryam alaihis-salaam ne apne hawaariyyeen se kaha tha ke Allah ki raah mein mera madadgaar kaun hai, to hawaariyyeen ne kaha ke hum Allah ke naasir hain. Lekin phir Bani Israaeel mein se ek giroh imaan le aaya aur ek giroh kaafir ho gaya, to hum ne saahibaan-e-imaan ki dushman ke muqaable mein madad kar di to woh ghaalib aa kar rahe
